is-idle.description:
Task Specification: idle.etasl.lua
Set to true to indicate that the task uses the task specification mentioned above. 
 Task description: Keeps the robot in an idle state: no constraints are imposed, so the commanded joint velocities are zero and the robot stays still, while the controller keeps running (e.g. so that joint states and outputs keep being published).
The robot model must contain the frame "tcp_frame". Outputs: position (x_tf, y_tf, z_tf) [m] and roll/pitch/yaw angles (roll_tf, pitch_tf, yaw_tf) [rad] of tcp_frame w.r.t. the robot base frame (root frame of the robot model).
It has no parameters, no input channels and no exit monitor: it runs until it is stopped externally (e.g. by the skill/state machine).
